defensiveAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Partitioned Anatomy
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The mukradi would be Confused, Paralyzed, Slowed, or Stunned

Effect The mukradi confines the debilitating effect to a certain portion of its nervous system, ignoring the effect but causing a maw of its choice to go dormant for the effect's duration. That maw can't be used for a Strike or to Breathe Energy during that time. This ability can't be used if all the mukradi's heads are dormant.

defensiveAbilities.name: Spitting Rage
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature scores a critical hit on the mukradi

Effect The mukradi's Breathe Energy recharges. It can use Breathe Energy immediately as part of this reaction. It can't use this reaction again until it recharges Breathe Energy naturally.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breathe Energy
offensiveAbilities.description:
The mukradi breathes a blast of energy from one of its three heads; each creature in the area must attempt a Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw save.

The mukradi can't Breathe Energy again for 1d4 rounds.

  • Acid Maw (acid) 10-foot-wide, 60ft Line of acid dealing 16d6 Acid Damage damage.
  • Flame Maw (fire) 60ft Cone of fire dealing 16d6 Fire Damage damage.
  • Shock Maw (electricity) 120ft Line of electricity dealing 16d6 Electricity Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pull Apart
offensiveAbilities.description:
The mukradi makes two Strikes with different maws against the same target. If both hit, the target takes an extra (2d12+13) Slashing Damage damage, with a Basic DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a critical failure, the creature is torn to pieces and dies.

The mukradi's multiple attack penalty increases only after all the attacks are made.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thrash
offensiveAbilities.description: The mukradi Strikes once against each creature in its reach. It can make one of these Strikes with each of its maws, one with its tail lash, and the rest with its legs. Each attack takes a –2 circumstance penalty and counts toward the mukradi's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks are made.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Huge or smaller, leg, Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
